source: 744 Approach
target: 744 Accessus

source: The moment Lumian saw those iron‑black eyes, his mind went completely blank.
target: Momento quo Lumian illos oculos, nigros ut ferro, vidit, mens eius prorsus vacua facta est.

source: When he came to, he was shocked to find himself walking step by step toward the massive iron throne without any intention to do so.
target: Cum se evigilavit, stupens invenit se passu post passum procedere ad magnum thronum ferreum, neque ulla voluntate ad hoc agendum in animo habens.

source: He could feel his body trembling uncontrollably, yet he was powerless to stop his legs from moving.
target: Senti corpus suum inordinatim tremulare, sed non poterat crura sua detinere ne moverentur.

source: It seemed as though his body was no longer his own, obeying unknown commands and directed by someone else!
target: Apparuit quasi corpus eius non esset iam suum, ignotas praecepta obtemperans et ab alio rectus ducendus!

source: This scene, coupled with the figure on the iron throne possibly being Blood Emperor Alista Tudor, instantly reminded Lumian of two past incidents: One was at the Samaritan Women’s Spring, where both he and Hela lost consciousness due to the violent reactions of the Blood Emperor’s apparition, walking back to the edge of the spring as if they were puppets being manipulated or soldiers absolutely obeying orders.
target: Haec scaena, coniuncta cum figura in throno ferreo – quae fortasse esset Sanguinis Imperator Alista Tudor – statim Lumian duos casus praeteritos commemoravit: unum ad Fontem Samaritarum Feminarum, ubi et ipse et Hela sensum amiserunt propter vehementes reactiones apparitionis Imperatoris Sanguinis, redeuntes ad limen fontis tamquam pupae manipulatae aut milites prorsus oboediens mandatis.

source: The other was in the depths of the Red Swan Castle’s underground labyrinth, where he, Albus, and Elros lost consciousness after hearing a phantom roar from Vermonda Sauron in Fourth Epoch Trier, and they all wandered away from the core area, each towards a different wax sculptor.
target: Alterum fuit in profundis labyrinthi subterranei Castelli Cygni Rubri, ubi ipse, Albus, et Elros sensum amiserunt postquam rugitum phantasmaticum a Vermonda Sauron in Aetate Quarta Trier audierunt, et omnes a regione centrali erraverunt, unusquisque versus alium sculptorem cerae.

source: Could this be a similar situation now?
target: Numquid haec condicio nunc similis sit?

source: Is this a capability at the Hunter’s angelic level?
target: Estne haec facultas ad gradus angelicos Venatoris?

source: Lumian forced himself to calm down to find a way out of his current predicament.
target: Lumian se compulit ad se tranquillandum, ut viam e praesenti difficultate inveniret.

source: Compared to those two times, at least his consciousness recovered quickly this time!
target: Comparatis illis duobus temporibus, saltem mens eius hoc tempore celeriter restituta est!

source: Right, why did my consciousness awaken first this time, while my body still accepts control?
target: Recte, cur mens mea hoc tempore prima evigilavit, cum corpus meum adhuc imperio subiectum maneret?

source: Is the figure of Alista Tudor here weaker and less powerful, or is there another reason?
target: Num figura Alista Tudor hic infirmior et minor potentia sit, an aliud quidem causa existat?

source: Perhaps this anomaly holds the key to overcoming the control.
target: Fortasse haec anomalia clavem continet ad imperium superandum.

source: Lumian strained to extend his will towards his limbs, trying to regain control over them.
target: Lumian studuit voluntatem suam ad membra extenderet, conatus eas iterum dominari reddere.

source: This had some effect; his steps toward the iron throne began to slow.
target: Hoc efficaciter operatus est; gradus eius versus thronum ferreum incipiebant tardare.

source: He also took the opportunity to get a clearer look at the figure of Alista Tudor on the throne: The Blood Emperor had a stern face with sharp, chiseled features, resolute lips, a prominent nose, and long hair gleaming with a faint blood‑light, his iron‑black eyes cold yet filled with ultimate madness.
target: Praeterea, occasione uteatus est ut figuram Alista Tudor in throno melius intueretur: Sanguinis Imperator vultum severum habebat, lineamenta acuta et sculpta, labia obstinata, nasum eminentem, ac capillos longos leviter sanguine luce fulgentis, cum oculis ferrei nigri, frigidis sed plenos extremae insaniae.

source: Suddenly, Lumian felt an urge to submit, to give up resistance.
target: Subito, Lumian desiderium sensit ut se submitteret, ut repugnationem deserere inciperet.

source: This impulse did not fade quickly but instead swelled rapidly, filling his mind.
target: Hic impetus celeriter non evanuit, sed potius rapido crescebat, mentem eius replens.

source: No, I can’t resist…
target: Non, non possum resistere…

source: There’s no way to resist…
target: Nulla via est resistendi…

source: Submit, submission will grant everything…
target: Cede, nam submissio omnia praestabit…

source: If He becomes angry, I will be destroyed, and Franca and Jenna will also be destroyed…
target: Si ille irascitur, delebor, et Franca atque Jenna quoque delebuntur…

source: Give up, give up, kneel down and beg for forgiveness, accept the command…
target: Cede, cede, genu flecte et veniam obsequia, imperium accipe…

source: Such thoughts surged in Lumian’s mind, turning into violent waves that battered his clarity, rationality, and will.
target: Talia cogitationes in mente Lumiani eruperunt, in fluctus violentos transformantes, qui claritatem, rationem, atque voluntatem eius percutiebant.

source: He clenched his teeth, as if any relaxation would break the final dam, and the flood would completely drown his will and soul.
target: Dentes contraxit, quasi quaelibet relaxatio ultimum claustrum rumpere posset, et diluvium omnino voluntatem ac animam eius submergere vellet.

source: His previously slowed steps quickened again.
target: Gradus eius, antea retardati, iterum festinaverunt.

source: On the deck of the Blue Avenger.
target: In ponte Vindex Caerulei.

source: Magician and The Hanged Man were both staring at the dreamlike veil suspended in midair.
target: Magus et Vir Appensus uterque ad velum quasi somniculosum in aere suspenditum spectabant.

source: Against a backdrop of starlight, Lumian’s figure on the translucent curtain had already become blurred, the surrounding darkness rendering everything else invisible.
target: Sub lumine stellarum, figura Lumiani in velamento translucido iam offuscata erat, et tenebra circumiecta omnia reliqua invisibilia reddebant.

source: This obscurity compared to the previous clarity indicated that something unusual was happening.
target: Haec obscuritas, comparata ad pristinam claritatem, significabat aliquid insolitum evenire.

source: The eyes of Magician and The Hanged Man saw Lumian’s body growing increasingly rigid, yet his pace quickening.
target: Oculi Magi et Viri Appensi viderunt corpus Lumiani gradatim rigidari, sed simul celeritatem augeri.

source: They also noticed his black hair slowly lengthening, tinted with a blood‑like glow.
target: Etiam animadvertebant capillos eius nigros lente crescere, et rubore quasi sanguine simili tinctos.

source: “Something’s off,” The Hanged Man Alger, said, turning to Madam Magician beside him.
target: “Aliquid non rectum est,” inquit Vir Appensus Alger, convertens ad Dominam Magam iuxta se.

source: Magician nodded slightly, preparing to pull out a Sealed Artifact.
target: Magus leviter annuit, se praeparans ad extrahendum Artefactum Sigillatum.

source: This would help her precisely locate Lumian and allow her direct entry into the hidden extradimensional space.
target: Hoc ei adiuverit ut Lumian exacte detegeret atque ei directum ingressum in spatium extradimensionale celatum concederet.

source: In the dim surroundings, Lumian walked forward with a blank, rigid expression.
target: In tenebris circumiectis, Lumian procedebat vultu immutato et rigido.

source: Yet his soul was struggling, crying out in pain:
target: Attamen anima eius luctabatur, clamans in dolore:

source: I can’t give up…
target: Non possum desistere…

source: J mustn’t give up…
target: Non debeo cedere…

source: If I lose my resolve, I will no longer be myself…
target: Si fidem meam amittam, non amplius ipse ero…

source: Dogsh*t…
target: Stercus caninum…

source: Son of a sow…
target: Filius scrofae…

source: Lumian exerted all his strength, but felt an increasing desire to submit.
target: Lumian omnem virtutem suam adhibuit, sed crescentem desiderium subiendi sensit.

source: Suddenly, the dam holding his will collapsed, and surrender and submission completely overtook him.
target: Subito, impedimentum voluntatis eius corruit, et submissio eum penitus comprehendorum coepit.

source: Lumian’s mind went blank again.
target: Mens Lumiani iterum vacua facta est.

source: In this state, he had no concept of how much time had passed, until a deathly cold and rot‑like pain shot through his right palm.
target: In hoc statu, neque tempus aestimare poterat, donec frigidus letalis atque putrida dolor per palam dextram eius transiit.

source: Death… cold…
target: Mors… frigida…

source: Rot… pain…
target: Putredo… dolor…

source: Pain…
target: Dolor…

source: Lumian was jolted awake, suddenly regaining his thoughts and a measure of control over his body.
target: Lumian subito permotus evigilavit, mox cogitationes suas atque aliquam dominationem corporis sui recuperans.

source: Before him was not the nine‑stepped dais or the huge iron throne marked with red, but a mirror.
target: Ante eum non erat podium novem gradibus nec magnus thronus ferreus rubro signatus, sed speculum.

source: An antique full‑length mirror, framed with elaborate silver designs!
target: Speculum priscum totius longitudinis, operibus argenteis elaboratissimis ornatum!

source: The mirror reflected Lumian’s figure.
target: Speculum figuram Lumiani repraesentabat.

source: In the mirror, Lumian saw his face contorted with pain, looking like he might give up at any moment, while his facial contours slowly sharpened and his nose became unnaturally prominent.
target: In speculo, Lumian vidit faciem suam dolore contortam, quae suggerebat se statim cedere posse, dum lineamenta faciei eius lente affiliebantur et nasus inusitate eminentior factus est.

source: At the same time, his black hair grew inch by inch, dyed with a bloody glow, and his blue eyes turned colder, edging toward iron‑black.
target: Simul, capilli eius nigri pollice per pollice crescebat, colore sanguine simili tincti, et oculi eius caerulei frigidi facti sunt, quasi ad ferreos nigros inclinantes.

source: Jam turning into Alista Tudor…
target: Iam se in Alista Tudor transformari coepit…

source: This realization dawned on Lumian.
target: Haec intuitio in Lumiano ortum est.

source: Without thinking further, while his body still somewhat obeyed his commands, he immediately lunged to the side, trying to escape the reflection of the silver mirror.
target: Sine plura cogitando, dum corpus eius adhuc partim mandatis oboediens remanebat, statim ad latus impetum fecit, ut a reflexione speculi argentati effugeret.

source: A dive followed by a roll quickly took him out of the mirror’s reflective range.
target: Submissa deinde gyratio celeriter eum extra ambitum speculi repraesentationis evellit.

source: The next second, he heard a phantom roar, a mad scream.
target: Secundo proximo, audivit rugitum phantasmaticum, insani clamorem.

source: His mind blanked out again.
target: Mens eius iterum vacua facta est.

source: As his thoughts gradually returned, he found himself still crouched on the ground, the endpoint of his roll.
target: Dum cogitationes eius paulatim redierunt, se invenit adhuc in terra collapso statu, ad extremum gyrationis.

source: His body hadn’t moved toward the mirror on its own, but it couldn’t stop shaking, as if his blood had frozen.
target: Corpus eius non ipso se movit ad speculum, sed tremulationem prohibere non poterat, quasi sanguis eius congelatus esset.

source: Bang! Bang! Bang!
target: Bang! Bang! Bang!

source: It seemed as if something inside the mirror was madly pounding, making the mirror clatter as if it were about to shatter and release a monster.
target: Videbatur quasi aliquid intra speculum insaniter pulsaret, faciens ut speculum stridore resonaret, quasi paene dissolveretur atque monstrum effugeret.

source: And with each bang against the mirror, Lumian’s mind felt the impact, over and over.
target: Et singulis ictibus contra speculum, mens Lumiani impactionem iterum atque iterum sentiebat.

source: This gripped him with fear, nearly solidifying his thoughts.
target: Hoc eum metu comprehendit, fere cogitationes eius rigidans.

source: After a while, the pounding inside the mirror gradually subsided, and the surroundings became eerily quiet.
target: Post aliquot tempora, pulsus intra speculum gradualiter cessavit, et ambitus mirabiliter quietus factus est.

source: Lumian’s body stopped shaking, and he began to understand and reflect on his current situation and recent ordeal: If I had really approached that full‑length mirror, and the reflection had completed the transformation, would that mean that Blood Emperor Alista Tudor would be resurrected within me?
target: Corpus Lumiani non amplius tremuit, et ille coepit intellegere atque meditari de sua praesenti condicione et nuper experienti: si revera ad illud speculum totius longitudinis accederet, et reflectio transformationem compleverit, an id significaret Sanguinis Imperator Alista Tudor intra me resuscitaturum esse?

source: But as long as I’m not reflected in that mirror, and my image isn’t cast upon it, the impact will be minimal, and neither my will nor my body will lose command…
target: Sed dummodo in illo speculo non repraesentarer, neque imago mea in eo projiceretur, ictus minimus erit, nec voluntas nec corpus meum imperium amittentur…

source: Is the trigger for this transformation entering the range of the full‑length mirror’s reflection?
target: Num incitamentum huius transformationis in ambitum speculi totius repraesentationis intrat?

source: It seems calm now…
target: Nunc tranquillus videtur…

source: Lumian slowly supported himself up, cautiously observing his surroundings.
target: Lumian lente se sublevavit, caventer circumiecta observans.

source: He realized he was not in a somber hall, but in a bizarre starlight‑formed space where the floor appeared semi‑transparent, revealing endless darkness below, and no dome above, only twinkling yet ethereal stars.
target: Animadvertit se non in aula tristi versari, sed in spatio mirabili a luce stellarum constituto, ubi pavimentum semitransparens videbatur, ostendens tenebras sine fine subtus, neque tecta super, sed tantum astra micantia ac aetherea.

source: On either side were doors of starlight, erect in the darkness, forming a wide, somber corridor that ended with the silver full‑body mirror.
target: In utrisque lateribus erant ianuae luminis stellarum, in tenebris erectae, quae latum atque solemniter triste corridor formabant, qui finem habebat in speculo argenteo totius corporis.

source: At this moment, Lumian had reached deep into this corridor, only about fifteen meters from the mirror.
target: Hoc tempore, Lumian alte in hoc corridor pervenit, soli circiter quindecim metris a speculo.

source: Was the hall I saw earlier, the stone chair, the iron throne, and the figure of the Blood Emperor all illusions?
target: Num aula quam ante vidi, cathedra lapidea, thronus ferreus, et figura Sanguinis Imperatoris omnia erant illusiones?

source: Was their purpose to make me submit?
target: Eratne propositum eorum ut me subicere?

source: No, if I had been reflected in the mirror, the one emitting the roar I just heard would have achieved their goal…
target: Non, si in speculo repraesentar, ille qui rugitum phantasmaticum emittens audiveram, propositum suum assecutus fuisset…

source: In a flash of insight, Lumian guessed: Perhaps, the illusions I saw earlier—the iron throne, the figure of Tudor, the broken stone chair— were resonances caused by the residual aura of the Blood Emperor within me and that silver full‑length mirror, which also triggered a response from the Underworld Daoist’s brand, helping me briefly escape the controlled state and the mirror’s reflective range.
target: In momento intuitus, Lumian coniectavit: fortasse illae illusiones quas ante vidi – thronum ferreum, figuram Tudor, cathedram lapideam fractam – erant resonantiae a residua aura Sanguinis Imperatoris in me atque in illo speculo argenteo totius longitudinis, quae etiam responsum excitaverunt ab insigni signo Daoista Inferorum, quod mihi ad tempus ex statu coercito et extra ambitum speculi repraesentationis effugiendum auxilium tulit.

source: Thinking this, Lumian raised his right hand, looking at his palm.
target: Hoc cogitans, Lumian dextram manum levavit, palmam suam intuens.

source: There, the pale red scar was vibrant as if just entered into his body, while the pale skin around it showed clear signs of decay, leaking a pale yellow fluid, and revealing the bones beneath.
target: Ibi, cicatrix pallide rubra vivebat, quasi modo in corpus intravisset, dum cutis pallida circa eam claras significationes corruptionis ostendebat, effundens liquorem luteum pallidum, et ossa subjacentes revelans.

source: This preliminary confirmed Lumian’s suspicion.
target: Hoc praevius suspicionem Lumiani confirmavit.

source: He once again turned his gaze toward the silver full‑length mirror facing him.
target: Iterum oculos suos convertebat ad speculum argenteum totius corporis, quod ei occurreret.

source: Having dealt with the Mirror People multiple times, he slightly furrowed his brows: Does the Blood Emperor want to use that mirror and His residual aura within me for resurrection?
target: Cum Populo Specularum plurimas lites egisset, leviter supercilia contraxit: num Sanguinis Imperator illud speculum atque residuam auram in me ad resurrectionem uti velit?

source: There must be something hidden inside that mirror.
target: Necesse est aliquid in illo speculo latere.

source: The Blood Emperor’s resurrection setup actually involves the mirror world…
target: Constitutio resurrectionis Sanguinis Imperatoris re vera in mundo speculi includitur…

source: Yeah, that’s not unusual, whether it’s the special mirror world itself or the Mirror People from that world, they are all related to this Blood Emperor’s Fourth Epoch Trier…
target: Ita, hoc non est insolitum, sive ipse mundus speculi specialis sive Populus Specularum ex eo mundo, omnia ad hunc Sanguinis Imperatoris Aetatem Quartam Trier pertinere.

source: I had thought the special mirror world was a relic of the War of the Four Emperors, but Moran Avigny from the Tamara family said their connection to the special mirror world was established before the War of the Four Emperors…
target: Putabam mundum speculi specialis reliquiam esse Belli Quattuor Imperatorum, sed Moran Avigny ex familia Tamara dixit nexum eorum ad mundum speculi specialem ante Bellum Quattuor Imperatorum constitutum esse.

source: Dammit, that special mirror world couldn’t have been created by the Blood Emperor, could it?
target: Heu, ille mundus speculi specialis a Sanguinis Imperatore creari non potuit, an ita sit?

source: How many problems has He left for this world?
target: Quot difficultates ille huic mundo reliquit?

source: As expected of the Blood Emperor known for His madness…
target: Ut exspectatum erat ab Imperatore Sanguinis, cui nota est insania eius…

source: But clearly, the special mirror world can’t avoid the Primordial Demoness…
target: Sed plane, mundus speculi specialis Demonissa Primigenia vitare non potest…

source: Could it be that the Demoness Sect secretly lured the Tamara family, trying to subtly influence the Blood Emperor through the special mirror world?
target: Num forte secta Demonissae occulto modo familiam Tamara allexit, conata subtiliter Sanguinem Imperatorem per mundum speculi specialem influere?

source: In the end, it was used by the Blood Emperor?
target: Denique, id ab Imperatore Sanguinis usum est?

source: Fourth Epoch Trier is indeed full of mysteries…
target: Aetas Quarta Trier re vera plurima mysteria continet…

source: As Lumian pondered, he suddenly understood why Termiboros had initially prevented him from exploring the Blue Avenger.
target: Dum Lumian meditabat, subito intellexit cur Termiboros initio eum explorare Vindex Caeruleum prohibuisset.

source: To explore here, one would need either the Underworld Daoist’s brand to seal the Blood Emperor’s residual essence or some corresponding artifact or authority to counteract that domination; otherwise, one would become a puppet of Alista Tudor, allowing Him to resurrect within.
target: Ad hoc explorandum, aut signum Daoista Inferorum ad essentiam residuam Sanguinis Imperatoris sigillandam necessarium esset, aut aliquod artifactum vel auctoritas conveniens ad dominatum repugnandum; alioquin quispiam puppa Alista Tudor fient, quod Illi resurrectionem intra efferre patitur.

source: For Termiboros, this was definitely not a good thing.
target: Pro Termiboro, hoc certe non bonum erat.

source: Lumian’s gaze shifted, focusing on the doors of starlight.
target: Aspectus Lumiani mutatus est, et ianuas luminis stellarum intuebatur.

source: Did they represent different treasures?
target: Num diversa thesauros repraesentabant?
